tasks.label: Verify calling pool allocation
args: import { prisma } from './lib/db'; import { processBulkCallingImport } from './services/import.service'; import { assignCallingPool } from './services/assignment.service'; const run = async () => { const phones = ['+919900000101', '+919900000102', '+919900000103']; await prisma.lead.deleteMany({ where: { phone: { in: phones } } }); const admin = await prisma.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { email: 'nehra@orvion.com' } }); const exec = await prisma.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { email: 'shubham@orvion.com' } }); const session = { id: admin.id, name: admin.name, email: admin.email, role: admin.role as any }; const imported = await processBulkCallingImport({ rows: phones.map((phone, index) => ({ clientName: `Pool Probe ${index + 1}`, phone, campaign: 'Pool Probe', callDate: '2026-09-20', callTime: '11:00' })), assignmentMode: 'UNASSIGNED', user: session }); if (imported.createdCount !== 3 || imported.assignedCount !== 0) throw new Error(`Unexpected import result: ${JSON.stringify(imported)}`); const assigned = await assignCallingPool({ count: 2, newOwnerId: exec.id, performer: session }); const records = await prisma.lead.findMany({ where: { phone: { in: phones } }, select: { currentOwnerId: true } }); const owned = records.filter((record) => record.currentOwnerId === exec.id).length; const waiting = records.filter((record) => record.currentOwnerId === null).length; if (assigned.assignedCount !== 2 || owned !== 2 || waiting !== 1) throw new Error(`Unexpected allocation state: ${JSON.stringify({ assigned, owned, waiting })}`); console.log('CALLING POOL CHECK: PASS (3 imported, 2 assigned, 1 remains)'); await prisma.lead.deleteMany({ where: { phone: { in: phones } } }); }; run().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; }).finally(() => prisma.$disconnect());

args: $files = Get-ChildItem tests -Filter '*.test.ts' | Sort-Object Name; $failed = @(); foreach ($file in $files) { Write-Output ('=== ' + $file.Name + ' ==='); bun test $file.FullName; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $failed += $file.Name } }; if ($failed.Count -gt 0) { Write-Output ('FAILED: ' + ($failed -join ', ')); exit 1 } else { Write-Output ('ALL PASSED: ' + $files.Count + ' test files') }
